title: Senate Republicans seek Lutnick testimony on Nvidia enforcement
description: Senate Republicans are pressing U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify before Congress over allegations that his department failed to prevent Nvidia Corp.’s prized artificial intelligence chips from reaching China. Senator Jim Banks said he wants Lutnick to explain the “glaring mistakes” that allowed Megaspeed International, a Singapore-based cloud computing company accused of smuggling Nvidia chips to China, to avoid being placed on a U.S. export blacklist.
